call_definition.saved_fit_load: fixed input g and XDF full/selected,CDF14,CDF18 NPZ load; no other molecular exports
call_definition.explicit_initializer: one locked nonoptimized _double_factorized_explicit_cholesky at tol1e-8/max_vecs14 or18, same initializer as old CDF
call_definition.initialization_identity: compare regenerated initial J/U to saved full prefix, including column signs; rank14 also compare saved selected prefix; no gauge repair
call_definition.initial_codec: one old real=True df pack/unpack per rank, containing per-frame locked SciPy logm/expm and det/branch/projector diagnostics
call_definition.final_reencoding: one old codec pack/unpack of saved final J/U per rank, only to qualify a reconstructed chart gradient
call_definition.tensor_assessment: one original-g reconstruction/Frobenius/maxabs/.5 Frobenius^2 per rank/state; six total
call_definition.value_and_gradient: one existing fixed ffsim JAX value_and_grad at original x0 and (if tensor round-trip qualified) saved-final reencoded chart; max4; no minimize/optimizer
call_definition.final_optimizer_consistency: one final tensor objective vs saved fun comparison per rank; old stopping metadata/x/jac availability recorded
call_definition.input_and_snapshots_load: original h/g/c and six newly emitted J/U states for sector evaluation
call_definition.sector_context: one existing sparse SectorCAR Nalpha=Nbeta3 context
call_definition.physical_sector: one existing OF sparse physical h/g/c operator restricted to sector400, then densify
call_definition.sector_assessment: one existing rank_assessment per rank/state, including raw CAR reconstruction/spectral norm/unchanged engineering guard
call_definition.saved_sector_consistency: replay XDF14 before/CDF14 final/CDF18 final sector norms against saved scalar rows
call_definition.diagnosis: one paired before/after/final interpretation per rank from recorded tensor/sector metrics

allowances.qualification: Numerical diagnostics, no rigorous rounding enclosure; no post-result changes

initialization_equivalence: Old saved XDF_full used max_vecs21, actual18. Old CDF14/18 used max_vecs14/18; same locked explicit-Cholesky function/tol/input. Before any codec interpretation, regenerate ONLY these two nonoptimized initializers and verify same J/U including column signs against saved prefixes. Do not assume rank14 vs rank18 equivalence.
gradient_qualification: Original optimizer x and jac were discarded by old factor_worker and cannot be reconstructed as historical evidence. x0 gradient is the fixed original chart. Final gradient, if encoded tensor is preserved, is a newly evaluated reencoded-chart diagnostic, never the old final jac.
repair_scope: Column-sign normalization plus tensor round-trip guard tested on artificial data only; no repaired H6 codec evaluation or fit.
execution_order: per rank14/18 explicit initializer identity gate BEFORE old codec; before/after/final tensors and initial/final-chart objective gradients
eval-env one original physical sector and six state reconstructions; replay three saved norms
classify original conversion fidelity and retained optimizer evidence
publish partial or complete evidence and mandatory STOP

STOP.first_identity_contract_nonfinite_or_ref: preserve partial evidence, stop dependent work, retry/resume0
STOP.legacy_codec_tensor_degradation: expected diagnostic outcome, not a reason to skip saved final-state comparison

performance: Reuse sparse sector400, shared immutable input and six independent assessments; choose workers from actual affinity/quota/free memory and coordinate BLAS. No full dense4096/controlled8192, no artificial CPU/RAM/wall caps or shared-env changes.
permission_policy: User permission in chat suffices; no approval-proof record or new grant.
